name: Breeding Stock
description: You were kept as a source of strong breeding or sought out to enrich bloodlines.

traits: I take great pleasure in providing my body to further my bloodline of greatness.
I provide my body for breeding out of necessity, knowing it keeps me safe in some way.
I breed offspring to raise as followers for my grand design.
Breeding is an expression of love for the world, my lover, or my family.
I have no choice. This is my lot. I am resigned to it.
I have a distinct desire to constantly breed, and I can't control it.
I am very selective in who I breed with. Only the finest mates will do.
Despite my station, I have a deep love interest, and I would only give my body to them if it were possible.

ideals.text: Life. To bring and give life is the ultimate calling.
Family. My body for my family. Nothing else matters.
Influence. The more of my offspring in the world, the more power I will inevitably gain.
Duty. It is my duty to provide life for my family, whether in the bedchamber or the nursery.
Purity. I keep my bloodline pure by ensuring those I breed with are of the highest quality.
Glory. I earned my place as the finest breeding stock in the land, and I will enjoy my reward.

bonds: My position cements my family's alliance with another.
Nothing is greater to me than my familial duty.
My loyalty to my owner is unwavering.
I will break free from this station, one way or another.
I am in love with someone that I am not permitted to breed with.
I will further my glorious bloodline by any means necessary.
flaws: I hate the process of breeding, despite loving the outcome.
I cannot perform unless I am partially intoxicated.
My self-worth revolves around the number of suitors wanting to breed with me.
I would rather masturbate than be forced to have sex with other people.
My station is shameful in the eyes of those I look up to.
I will never breed with a different species than me for fear of dirtying my bloodline.
